messages.subject: dplyr package making it impossible to deploy Shiny app
parts:
Dear Shiny Wizards,

I've built the beginnings of a small Shiny app, but I'm having trouble deploying it when I include the dplyr package. With dplyr, it runs perfectly fine locally. When I take both the package and its associated functions out, it will not deploy to shinyapps.io. The error message and session info are attached below. 

With many thanks in advance for considering my question,

Alex

-Tareef

parts:
Hi Tareef,

But of course! Thanks so much for spotting that. It's now humming along like a charm. 

Really appreciate it,

Alex

On Thu, Feb 19, 2015 at 8:33 AM, Tareef Kawaf <tar...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Hi Alex,
It is possible that there are issues with dplyr v0.2 since it is quite old at this point.  Would you mind upgrading to a later version of dplyr and trying again?

-Tareef

On Wed, Feb 18, 2015 at 10:06 PM, Alex Bollfrass <boll...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear Shiny Wizards,

I've built the beginnings of a small Shiny app, but I'm having trouble deploying it when I include the dplyr package. With dplyr, it runs perfectly fine locally. When I take both the package and its associated functions out, it will not deploy to shinyapps.io. The error message and session info are attached below. 

With many thanks in advance for considering my question,

Alex
